description: This file defines an abstract class for node visitors in the Twig templating engine, facilitating compatibility across different versions of Twig.

classes.name:
Twig
odevisitor\AbstractNodeVisitor
classes.description: An abstract base class for implementing node visitors in Twig, providing methods for entering and leaving nodes during traversal, with deprecated support considerations.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Invoked when a node is first encountered; delegates to doEnterNode.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Invoked after a node's children have been visited; delegates to doLeaveNode.

methods.name: doEnterNode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, defining behavior upon entering a node.

methods.name: doLeaveNode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, defining behavior upon leaving a node.
